items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: He was supposed to with Eric Dolphy, supposed to be in the band when (inaudible) go to Europe with us.

ctx.x: Well, you've said that in a number of ways, and maintained that a long time, at a time when you were one of the most militant spokesmen that music had. And --

It's a police country, but there's more police in the ghettos. And they're murderers. I was told by Eric Dolphy, I had no way of knowing, nobody knows it, but when he was living in the South, right around the time when Martin Luther King was reigning, that they built concentration camps, with barbed wire and all that, and they said all they didn't have was the gas chambers. But he read that in Europe, in some European paper.
Who were they keeping in there?
